name: camera
description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Rounded rectangular outer shell has bounds x=2.15..21.85 and y=3.25..20.75. A circular lens counter and small indicator counter preserve recognition without overlapping strokes. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Not owner-approved.
